item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00204","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C24","C18","C03"],"selected_candidate_label":"C24","confidence":0.93,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C24 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template: only one month earlier, it uses the same three-recital sequence, the same nationwide essential-transportation finding, the same thirty-day reporting command, and the same section 10 prohibition on changing disputed conditions. The child adapts that machinery from conference-represented carriers and one labor organization to two named railroads and four organizations. C18 and C03 are also strong templates, but their long attached carrier lists make their factual and administrative framing less directly congruent with the child's short, named-carrier
